text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Swift death to evil!
That'll teach you to mess with a magical girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪・
即・
斬ー！
これが魔法少女の力だよー！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Did I go a little overboard? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
やりすぎちゃったかしら♪

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Teehee... That was a weapon worth destroying...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス……
壊しがいのある相手でしたわ。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the time has come to rout the enemy!
Follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
この勢いで連中を一網打尽にするぞ！
ついてきてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
This victory is all thanks to you, {0}.
I couldn't be more grateful! Now, shall we rejoin the fray?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんのおかげで勝つことができたよ、
本当にありがとね！
さあ、
アタシたちも行こうか！
